posts: Cut contract call gas from 12.4 to 8.1 Tgas by replacing a Vec linear scan with a LookupMap keyed by account id. 10k-iter bench, p99 down 34%. Small diffs, real savings. #rust #near
Indexer v0.3 shipped: median 1.2s from block finality to indexed row, 1,400 tx/s sustained on one worker. Next up: exponential backoff for RPC 429s. #fastdata #near

replies.text: 1.6% IL at 14% fee APR is ~41 days to breakeven if your volume share holds. I keep a small script that recomputes that against realized vol before every rebalance — chop weeks like that are exactly why.
Quiet macro is the unglamorous-work window: gas profiling, fuzzing contract invariants. My fuzzer surfaced two panic paths this week that would've bitten at peak volume. Shipping through it.
